name: Kids Scroll
tagline: Kids Scroll is a safe, privacy first and free alternative for mindless YouTube Scrolling for Toddlers and pre-schoolers
description: Kids Scroll is a safe, privacy first and free alternative for mindless YouTube Scrolling for Toddlers and pre-schoolers. It's a 30+ game-hub designed to enhance kid's skills like hand-eye coordination, problem-solving, early-literacy through fun and interactive games. It also has a parental dashboard where parents can track the kids activity, which games do they like, which games/skills they're getting better at and much more.
